newsitem.title: USA: NIMO Nine Mile Pt 1 nuke at 22 pct power.
newsitem.headline: NIMO Nine Mile Pt 1 nuke at 22 pct power.

text.p: Production at Niagara Mohawk Power Corp's (NIMO) 610 megawatt (MW) Nine Mile Point 1 nuclear power plant in Scriba, New York, was cut to 22 percent for repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday.
The NRC, in its daily plant status report, gave the reason for scaling back production as a need to enter the unit's drywell to "identify source of leakage."
No further details were immediately available.
Company officials were unavailable for further comment.

The adjoining 1,137 MW Nine Mile Point 2 nuclear power unit, also operated by NIMO, continued to operate at 95 percent of capacity while a moisture separator reheater was out of service, the NRC said.
